projects.title: Case Study: Department Store Manager
projects.description: Using UML, Class Diagram, Use Case Diagram, Association Matrix, and Data Dictionary to get basic requirement for department store system. This system involves two users; Department Store Manager and Administration. The two users have basic operations such as update stock, print and receive bills, manage items and their categories.
